The Role
As a Software Engineer on Bloomerang's PDLC Operations team, you will build the internal integrations and automations that connect how we build product with the teams who bring it to customers. With our AI-driven product development lifecycle, we ship faster than ever, and the handoffs to Marketing, Enablement, Sales, and our Customer teams have to keep up. Your job is to build the product knowledge layer that gives those teams the context and content they need, when they need it.
You'll report to the Sr. Manager, PDLC Operations, who sets the direction for our PDLC systems, and you'll turn that direction into working tools quickly. You'll build a version, put it in front of users, keep what works, and throw out what doesn't.
What You Will Do
Build the capture and classification steps that take content from Jira, GitHub, Notion, Figma, Pendo, and our data platforms such as BigQuery and Databricks, and promote only what partner teams need
Design and maintain a product knowledge repository with typed, sourced, and versioned content that keeps verified facts, decisions, ideas, and internal-only detail apart
Design and build role-scoped delivery through our internal AI harness, so Marketing, Sales, Enablement, and Customer teams get launch messaging, battlecards, help content, and training from verified sources, including inside the tools they already use, such as Salesforce, Gainsight, and Intercom
Automate repetitive PDLC work, such as go-live checklists, release notifications triggered by deploys and feature flag changes, and status roll-ups, so program and product managers can spend their time on decisions instead of coordination
Prototype several approaches quickly, test them with the people who will use them, and iterate or discard based on what you learn
Extend and improve our internal apps and dashboards built on tools such as Replit, including portfolio and capacity planning and delivery health metrics
Build AI-assisted workflows, Claude skills, and Slack bots that answer questions about work in flight from the product knowledge repository
Work with Product, Engineering, Program Management, Product Analytics, and go-to-market teams to understand their needs and turn them into simple tools
Build securely and responsibly, respecting access controls, data handling standards, and audit requirements such as SOC 2 traceability between code and work items
Document what you build so others can use, support, and maintain it
What You Need to Succeed
Experience building and maintaining web applications, APIs, and integrations in a modern language such as Python or TypeScript/JavaScript
Comfortability working with REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication for third-party tools
Solid software engineering fundamentals, including testing, debugging, and Git-based workflows with code review
Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and LLMs, such as Claude Code, and the ability to build and use agent harnesses and automated workflows to build and iterate quickly
A bias toward shipping: you're happy to build a quick first version, learn from it, and start over without attachment when a better approach appears
Curiosity about how teams work, and the habit of understanding the problem before building the solution
Clear communication with non-technical partners, including explaining tradeoffs in plain language
Effective collaboration with a manager who owns the vision, while bringing your own ideas and pushing back when something won't work
Ability to actively explore, learn, and responsibly integrate AI tools into daily tasks to drive efficiency and support Bloomerang's mission.
Experience with content models, metadata, or knowledge graphs, and with provenance and versioning of content in Git
Nice to Haves But Not Required
Experience with LLM-assisted classification, and evaluation of AI answer quality
Familiarity Atlassian, GitHub, Notion, or Slack APIs; Salesforce, Gainsight, Intercom, or Pendo APIs
Previous experience with MCP servers; Replit; or SQL and data warehouses (BigQuery, Databricks, etc)

Lead high-impact AI/ML and data engineering projects across ASG portfolio companies, partnering directly with operating companies to design, build, and deliver solutions
Build hands-on across AI/ML systems, including data pipelines, model integrations, internal LLM applications, APIs, and supporting infrastructure
Develop LLM-powered tools and workflows that enhance business operations, internal productivity, and product capabilities
Partner with portfolio companies to identify opportunities to commercialize data through new products, features, and analytics offerings
Serve as a technical leader and trusted advisor to engineering and data teams across the portfolio, helping shape practical approaches to AI and data adoption

Help establish repeatable patterns, playbooks, and best practices for building and deploying AI/ML and data solutions across multiple companies

Familiarity with LLM-based applications, model APIs, retrieval workflows, evaluation approaches, and production deployment patterns

Experience developing solutions and analyzing data in Python, R and SQL
Excellence in data validation — ensuring solutions developed with LLM and ML technologies produce results that are valid and grounded in reality
Understanding of fine tuning an LLM and strong understanding of inference economics and good judgment about when it’s better to use a frontier model or fine tune a smaller or open source model
Experience with developing solutions to reliably perform forecasting of various metrics (such as: sales projections, budget forecasts, resource consumption, demand forecasting, capacity planning, etc)
Experience translating business problems and data opportunities into practical AI/ML solutions
Knowledge of modern data architecture and best practices across ingestion, transformation, governance, quality, and access

Curiosity and discipline to stay current with the latest advancements in AI tooling, LLMs, and applied ML systems
Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, product, data, and business stakeholders
Comfortable supporting cross-company enablement through knowledge sharing, collaboration, and practical guidance

You are a builder who would rather fix the system than fix the same ticket twice. Generate's Data & Technology team runs the data platform the whole firm depends on, and we are increasingly replacing SaaS tools, spreadsheets, and manual processes with software we build ourselves. This role sits at the center of both: keeping our data pipelines healthy today and helping build the tools that come next. You're comfortable debugging code you didn't write, you enjoy working directly with the people who use what you build, and AI agents are already central to how you work.



What you will be doing at Generate Capital as a Software Engineer, Data:

 - Own the day-to-day health of our data pipelines: Python ETL jobs, dbt models in Snowflake, Azure Data Factory pipelines, and the reports and system integrations that depend on them.

 - Triage failures to root cause and fix them, from vendor schema changes and API rate limits to failed model tests and broken dependencies.

 - Work directly with stakeholders across the business to understand the impact of an issue, keep them informed, and confirm the resolution actually solved their problem.

 - Collaborate with the data team on fixes, code reviews, and releases.

 - Treat every recurring ticket as a design problem, adding the alerting, validation, retries, and schema-change handling that stop a whole class of failure from coming back.

 - Proactively find weaknesses in process, architecture, code quality, and security before they break, and drive the fix.

 - Help define and enforce repeatable patterns for quality and security across deployment, logging, testing, and secrets handling.

 - Help build, ship, and run internal applications that replace SaaS vendors, spreadsheets, and manual processes.

 - Sit with business stakeholders, translate their problems into requirements and prototypes, and turn those into working software.

 - Use AI coding agents as your default way of working, and share your workflows and tooling so the whole team gets faster.



Candidate qualifications & core characteristics:

 - A demonstrated passion for, or commitment to, our mission.

 - 2–3 years of professional software or data engineering experience. Exceptional new graduates with substantial shipped work will be considered.

 - Strong Python and SQL.

 - Experience building or operating software in a cloud environment. Azure is preferred; AWS or GCP experience is welcome.

 - AI coding agents are already central to how you work, and you can walk us through your workflow in detail.

 - Comfort debugging systems you didn't build, under time pressure, with incomplete information.

 - Ability to translate business problems into technical solutions.

 - Experience with Snowflake and dbt is a plus.

 - Experience building internal tools or full-stack applications is a plus.

 - Experience in financial services, energy, or another data-heavy environment is advantageous.

 - Unimpeachable integrity and glowing references.

 - Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, including empathy, intuition, and listening as well as strong writing and documentation skills.

 - High level of self-awareness and humility, with excitement about confronting uncomfortable situations or new challenges.

 - Intellectual agility, curiosity, and creativity; problem-solving is your default mode.

 - Entrepreneurial spirit: flexibility, comfort with risk, recognition that “perfect can be the enemy of the good”.



This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA.
